name: rtl-advisor
description: Evidence-backed RTL alternatives, formal proof, and same-flow synthesis through the local RTL Advisor CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Review RTL before synthesis with traceable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Review approved open RTL or qualified corpus references, prepare an isolated registered alternative, apply its P1 or P2 proof contract, and explain measured Yosys/ABC evidence without changing the source.
defaultPrompt: Review approved RTL for timing opportunities.
Compare a qualified open-RTL reference with its registered implementation alternative.
Explain whether synthesis likely handles this RTL rewrite.
Show the evidence behind this RTL finding.
Measure a formally proven candidate in both pinned synthesis recipes.
Visualize stored RTL Advisor regressions and recipe sensitivity.
Audit independent RTL design lineages and corpus qualification gaps.
